businessDifference.conflictSummary: 暂停清场与新 run 启动都会清空 Client UI 次数，Cloud 天庭也始终从 0 初始化，导致热恢复丢失累计次数并可能多跑。
businessDifference.userDecision: 暂停继续清除瞬时状态，但保留数值累计次数；同任务同总数的 PAUSE_RESUME 将该值交给 Cloud，天庭按剩余次数继续。

connectivity.producer: Client WindowRuntimeContext 在暂停清场前保存 exact-window 天庭 completed/total
connectivity.transport: TurnTaskStartRequest.taskInitialCompletedRuns 与 task queue 索引对齐传到 Cloud runtime metadata
connectivity.consumer: TiantingTask 同时初始化 completedSubtasks、GameContext 与首次 UI progress
connectivity.ordering: running progress -> pause snapshot -> volatile reset -> matching PAUSE_RESUME -> accepted new run -> retained progress -> remaining-count loop
